options.label: Entities
options.hint: 1 to 6 things that are on or off (or any entity: its state shows as text). More are a grid.

options.label: Title
options.hint: Empty: none on a grid; the name on one entity.

options.label: Icon
options.hint: Empty or auto: the entity's own or one from its kind. Or any icon such as mdi:coffee-maker.

options.label: State in words
options.hint: "On now" and the like, under a switch. Things that aren't on or off always show their state.

options.label: Starts from
options.hint: A state (on, off, open...) the switch slides from as the screen comes in. Empty: it starts where it is.

options.label: Something was just done
options.hint: Voice screens set it: the switch slides once, and the state reads as what happened.

options.label: And N more
options.hint: Shown as '+N more' under a grid.
